title: Surrogate Keys vs. Natural Keys
realWorldScenario: A team is debating whether to use Social Security Number (SSN) / PAN as the primary key for customer records, or an auto-incrementing integer / UUID.
questionStatement: Compare Natural Keys with Surrogate Keys. What are the operational and security risks of using real-world identifiers as primary keys?
expectedConcepts: Natural key vs Surrogate key definition
Cascading update vulnerability of natural keys
PII exposure risks in foreign key relationships
Index storage bloat of string keys
hints: What happens if a user legally changes their email address or government ID?
